name: Mark ClubSpark Package Import Items Imported

parameters.jsCode:
const sqlLiteral = (value) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
};
const request = $input.first()?.json ?? {};
const requestedValues = request.item_ids.map((id) => `(${Number(id)})`).join(',\n    ');
const sql = `
WITH requested_ids(item_id) AS (
  VALUES
    ${requestedValues}
),
selected AS (
  SELECT
    q.id,
    q.batch_id,
    q.member,
    q.target_membership,
    q.status,
    b.status AS batch_status
  FROM requested_ids r
  LEFT JOIN public.signup_batch_clubspark_import_items q
    ON q.id = r.item_id
  LEFT JOIN public.signup_batches b
    ON b.id = q.batch_id
  WHERE q.id IS NOT NULL
),
validation AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_ids) = 0 THEN 'Select at least one exported queue row to mark as imported.'
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selected) <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_ids) THEN 'One or more selected queue rows could not be found.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE batch_id <> ${Number(request.batch_id)}) THEN 'Selected rows must all belong to the requested batch.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE target_membership <> ${sqlLiteral(request.target_membership)}) THEN 'Selected rows must all belong to the requested target package.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE batch_status <> 'Processing') THEN 'Imported status can only be set while the batch is Processing.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE status <> 'exported') THEN 'Only exported queue rows can be marked as imported.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error_message
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE public.signup_batch_clubspark_import_items q
  SET status = 'imported',
      imported_at = now()
  FROM selected s, validation v
  WHERE v.error_message IS NULL
    AND q.id = s.id
  RETURNING q.id, q.member, q.target_membership
)
SELECT
  v.error_message,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated), 0) AS updated_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'member', member, 'target_membership', target_membership) ORDER BY member, id) FROM updated), '[]'::json) AS updated_rows
FROM validation v;`;
return [{ json: { ...request, sql } }];
